issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() as returning a boolean (should return true/false when milking succeeds), but the provided solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() with a String return type and Goat/Seal.messageOnMilk() return descriptive Strings. This return-type mismatch between specification and solution (and what students will expect to implement) is structural and will confuse or block students when implementing interfaces or matching tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for messageOnMilk() consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Change the problem statement and UML to specify that messageOnMilk() returns a String (and update textual descriptions to expect descriptive messages), or (B) Change the solution and template to have Milkable.messageOnMilk() return boolean and adjust Goat/Seal implementations and any code/tests that print the result accordingly. Preferably update the problem statement to match the solution (String) if the intent is to print a milking message.
